title: Pan-Seared Grilled Salmon with Couscous
description: A quick and easy meal featuring Pan-Seared Grilled Salmon served with a gluten-free Couscous.
instructions: 2. Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
3. Grill the salmon for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
5. Add the couscous to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
6. Fluff the couscous with a fork and season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Serve the grilled salmon on top of the couscous.
8. Garnish with lemon wedges and chopped fresh dill.
